meta.title: Order Activity records a surrogate bid added
gaps: Assert the exact buyer identity recorded for the surrogate bid.
Assert the exact date and time recorded for the activity entry.
Assert that activity entries are in chronological order and that no earlier entries are missing.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Assert the exact buyer identity recorded for the surrogate bid.; Assert the exact date and time recorded for the activity entry.; Assert that activity entries are in chronological order and that no earlier entries are missing.

steps.note: Open the eRFX create screen for an RFQ event.
Configure the event with an RFQ stage.
Work on the RFQ stage before configuring its template and sheet.
Apply the first available RFQ template.
Add a line item so the surrogate bid can be entered.
Invite a QA vendor eligible for surrogate bidding.
Publish the event so the buyer can add a surrogate bid.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.
Open the published RFQ Participants list where surrogate bidding is available.
Add a bid on behalf of the invited QA vendor.
Confirm the surrogate bid was accepted.
Open the RFQ stage's Order Activity drawer.
Confirm the activity drawer is open.
Check that the activity history contains text identifying the surrogate bid.
Check that an earlier event-creation activity remains visible in the history.
